articles.title: Algernon Health to rebrand as Grey Matters Health, sharpen focus on Alzheimer’s diagnostics
articles.mainIdea: Algernon Health to rebrand as Grey Matters Health, sharpen focus on Alzheimer’s diagnostics
articles.summary: Proactive: Algernon Health to rebrand as Grey Matters Health, sharpen focus on Alzheimer’s diagnostics. Algernon Health (CSE:AGN, OTCQB:AGNPF, FRA:AGW0) said on Wednesday it plans to change its corporate name to Grey Matters Health Inc, reflecting a strategic shift toward brain health and the growing Alzheimer’s disease diagnostics market. The company has reserved the new ticker symbol ‘GREY’... Related tickers mentioned: AGNPF.

articles.title: HCA Healthcare Kicks off Month of Volunteerism and Announces $2 Million HCA Healthcare Foundation Grant to Second Harvest Food Bank of Middle Tennessee
articles.mainIdea: HCA Healthcare Kicks off Month of Volunteerism and Announces $2 Million HCA Healthcare Foundation Grant to Second Harvest Food Bank of Middle Tennessee
articles.summary: Business Wire: HCA Healthcare Kicks off Month of Volunteerism and Announces $2 Million HCA Healthcare Foundation Grant to Second Harvest Food Bank of Middle Tennessee. NASHVILLE, Tenn., April 01, 2026--HCA Healthcare, Inc. (NYSE:HCA), one of the nation’s leading healthcare providers, today announced the HCA Healthcare Foundation will give $2 million to Second Harvest Food Bank of Middle Tennessee to support the development of their new Grow for Good campus in Nashville, Tennessee.
